driver.label: DuckLake
driver.description: DuckLake via the DuckDB JDBC driver. Host/Port/Database/User/Password point at the Postgres CATALOG; S3 storage is configured in Driver properties.

property.label: S3 endpoint (host:port)
property.description: S3 endpoint without scheme, e.g. localhost:9000 or s3.amazonaws.com. Leave blank for AWS default.

property.label: S3 access key
property.description: S3 access key id. Leave blank to use the AWS credential chain.

property.label: S3 region
property.description: e.g. us-east-1 (defaults to us-east-1 if blank)

property.label: S3 URL style
property.description: 'path' for MinIO/RustFS-style servers; blank = provider default (vhost)

property.label: S3 use SSL
property.description: On for https endpoints (AWS); off for local http

property.label: DuckLake DATA_PATH
property.description: Storage location, e.g. s3://bucket/prefix/ (trailing slash). Only needed when this ATTACH creates a brand-new catalog; existing catalogs store it in their metadata.

property.label: Metadata schema (Postgres)
property.description: Postgres schema holding this catalog's ducklake_* metadata tables (default 'public'). Selects which DuckLake catalog is the primary attach.

property.label: Catalog alias
property.description: Name the primary DuckLake is attached as (defaults to the metadata schema name, e.g. 'public')

property.label: Default schema (DuckLake)
property.description: Schema inside the primary catalog that unqualified table names resolve to (each connection runs USE alias.schema). Blank = main.

property.label: Discover all catalogs
property.description: Discover and attach every DuckLake catalog in the metadata database (one per Postgres schema). Default on.

property.label: Discover other databases
property.description: Also probe every other database on the Postgres server you may connect to, and attach its DuckLake catalogs as '<database>.<schema>'. Default on.
